title: Gratitude for Blessings - Hisn al-Muslim 81
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
transliteration: Allāhumma mā aṣbaha bī min ni`matin aw bi aḥadin min khalqik, fa minka waḥdaka lā sharīka lak, falaka 'l-ḥamdu wa lakash-shukr.
translation: O Allah, whatever blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon, is from You alone without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.
reference: Abu Dawud 4/318; An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (no. 7); Ibn As-Sunni (no. 41); Ibn Hibban (no. 2361); Ibn Baz, Tuhfatul-Akhyar, p. 24
